Cargo dependency notices for the Denghuo offline forecast module.
Versions and package checksums match the bundled Cargo.lock.
For dual-licensed crates this distribution selects MIT; unicode-ident also retains Unicode-3.0.
Build-time dependencies are included as notices as well. The original license texts follow.
Rust standard-library notices and their referenced licenses are in engine-source.zip under rust-runtime/.
